newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai steel firm to sign 20.45 bln baht loan pact.
newsitem.headline: Thai steel firm to sign 20.45 bln baht loan pact.

text.p: Thai Special Steel Industry, a unit of TPI Polene, on Thursday will sign an agreement to secure 20.45 billion baht ($786 million) loan from a German bank, a company official said on Wednesday.
The loan facility from Kreditanstalt fur Wiederaufbau will be used to finance the firm's 32 billion baht fully integrated steel project, she said.
The construction of the plant, located in eastern Rayong province, has progressed more than 60 percent and it is expected to start producing high quality wire rod by the end of this year.
The initial capacity will be around 500,000 tonnes a year, to eventually rise to 3.4 million tonnes later, she said. ($1 = 26 baht)
